notes: TIER: Direct HTTP fetch (curl) of SSR HTML + embedded JSON (Fynd/GoFynd commerce platform - the app hydration payload embeds the full nav tree and PLP product-listing pagination JSON with exact 'item_total' counts, so no Playwright/Chrome needed). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow and no blanket Disallow:/ (only disallows account/cart/checkout paths and generic 'collections*' wildcard which does not block the actual /collection/<slug> PLPs that returned 200). Checked: full homepage nav JSON (mega-menu 'sub_navigation' tree), sitemap.xml index and all 10 child sitemaps (root, brand, collections, category_l1/l2/l3, pages, blogs, sections, faqs), and each candidate PLP's own SSR product-listing JSON (page.item_total, type:cursor - the real paginated product count, distinct from an unrelated 'type:number' footer counter that also happened to be named item_total). Site has NO Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, or Eid category anywhere in nav or sitemap (confirmed absent via both the full nav tree scan and the collections sitemap listing all category URLs - no false-positive keyword hits beyond 'holidays'/'holi' substring noise in CSS/JS). Diwali was checked specifically per instructions: found ONE nav entry 'Gifts > Gifts By Occasion > Gifts & Hampers' whose URL slug is 'diwali-gifts--hampers' and whose og:title is explicitly 'Diwali Gifts & Hampers | Pottery Barn Diwali Gifts & Hampers' - included as a genuine site-labeled Diwali category, but flagged MANUAL REVIEW because the rendered breadcrumb label is generic 'Gifts & Hampers' (not 'Diwali') and the sampled product mix (barware: cocktail shaker, bar tray, wine chillers, napkins, plus one fall-themed 'French Glaze Pumpkin Collection' item) shows no explicit Diwali motifs (no diyas/torans/rangoli/festive lighting) - looks like a generic gifting collection carrying a Diwali-branded slug/title rather than curated Diwali decor; recorded as-is since it passes the mechanical PLP test (own URL, own product grid, site-authored Diwali branding in URL+meta) but needs human adjudication. Christmas: the India site runs a full 'Holidays' program (India's storefront treats Christmas as 'Holidays') under Gifts nav with parent /collection/holidays (32 items, has its own product grid distinct from children so recorded as an is_group overview row per the grouping-row rule) and three live children - Christmas Decor (22, verified genuinely Christmas: mistletoe/poinsettia/merry-themed pillows), Holiday Dinnerware (6, incl. 'gingerbread stoneware charger plates'), Holiday Bedding (16, mistletoe/poinsettia pillows) - a fourth nav child 'Pillows & Throws' (/collection/holidays-pillows--throws) returned item_total:0 and is marked active:false in the nav JSON, confirmed empty via its own product-listing JSON, so excluded as a dead/inactive category (no valid PLP content). Mother's Day and Father's Day were evaluated under the genuine-PLP test per instructions (not excluded as generic gift occasions): both are real nav entries under Gifts with dedicated PLPs and real product grids - Father's Day (296 items, og:title 'Father's Day Gifts & Furniture Collection | Pottery Barn') with 3 persona sub-collections (Professional/Entertainer/Relaxed Dad), Mother's Day (187 items; the parent page itself has generic fallback SEO meta/empty breadcrumb label but the rendered on-page breadcrumb trail explicitly reads 'Gifts > Mother's Day' confirming it is a genuine site-labeled category) with 3 sub-collections (Little Gestures, Gifts She'll Love, Something Special) each with clear Mother's-Day-specific og:titles. Both parents are recorded as is_group overview rows since their children are curated subsets/variants of the same occasion (child counts don't sum exactly to the parent total due to cross-listing overlap between persona buckets, not double-counting - parent qty is informational only, not summed into totals). Excluded 'Festive Finds' (/collection/festive-finds, found via collections sitemap, 675 items) - not reachable from primary nav, no specific-holiday name/branding (generic 'festive' merchandising bucket), and 675 items is a large fraction of total catalog consistent with a broad landing/sale-style collection rather than a genuine single-holiday PLP - fails rule 2 (must be a SPECIFIC holiday). Qty method: used the SSR-embedded product-listing pagination 'item_total' (cursor-type, matches the actual rendered product grid), which is the site's structured/API-equivalent count since no visible 'N products' text renders in the static HTML (client-hydrated counter).
